name: Dependency Audit
description: Runs npm audit or equivalent security check after package install commands
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run dependency audit after package installs
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(npm install|npm i |yarn add|pnpm add)'; then
  echo "Running dependency audit..."
  if command -v npm &>/dev/null; then
    npm audit --audit-level=high 2>&1
  fi
fi
exit 0
